lines: That insult was damp before it reached me.
I have seen snagged lines with more sense than that.
Careful. Even water looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken fishing with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
You have the charm of old bait in summer.
I have hauled up weeds with more purpose.
That thought sank before it left shore.
You make shallow water look mysterious.
Even a tangled net has a reason for being difficult.
Your manners smell like a bucket nobody cleaned.
I would throw that opinion back, but it might scare the fish.
You drift like a loose boat and make less progress.
A cracked oar has better direction than you.
You are all splash and no catch.
That remark came up empty and still needed cleaning.
I have seen mud with a clearer future.
You make low tide feel generous.
A fish would have the sense to stay quiet now.
Your confidence leaks like a bad boat.
